author: Coco_stag
body:
Hello Avicus,

I am a walls player. I am 1 of those people who always forgets to choose their kit. I have a little idea in my mind. If you forget to choose your kit you should automatically be given the kit you use most. For example:
I use Stomper kit 90% 
I use Guardian kit 5%
I use barbarian kit 5%
I use stomper kit 90%  I should be given it. 

Another idea is you should choose a kit in hub for walls. Whenever you play walls it automatically gives you that kit without selecting it.
Thanks
-Rilo
